reviewer: Codex, source-based content review; not independent human annotation

Q01: maxsize limits retained recent calls; None disables eviction
Q02: Use functools.cache or lru_cache for reusable function results
Repeated calls with the same arguments reuse cached results
Q03: contextmanager turns a generator into a context manager
Setup occurs before one yield, cleanup after it
Q05: Consumes lazily and yields batches as tuples
The final batch can be shorter under the default strict=False
Q07: chain(*iterables) or chain.from_iterable handles multiple input streams
Does not materialize the full concatenation
Q18: as_completed yields futures in completion order
Contrast with submitting-order iteration; completed future results can then be processed
Q19: Use ExitStack as a context manager
Register each opened file with enter_context dynamically
Previously entered resources close when a later open fails; stack unwinds on exit
Q24: A callable default_factory is called without arguments, and the result is inserted and returned
get() does not invoke __missing__ or the default factory
